alabama.note: Tourism puts peak from late October to early November; the mountains start in early October.

alaska.note: Interior color starts in mid-August; Southcentral peaks in September.

arizona.note: Highest elevations begin mid-September; Flagstaff is prime in early October and the show ends in late October.

arkansas.note: Ozarks peak in late October; south and east Arkansas follow into mid-November.

california.note: Eastern Sierra starts mid-September; coast and valleys run through November.

colorado.note: Aspens peak from late September into early October, later in the San Juans.

connecticut.note: Based on 2026 DEEP estimates, from northwest and northeast first to the shore and southwest last.

georgia.note: Based on the 2026 Forestry Commission forecast and reports, from the mountains down to the foothills.

idaho.note: Historically most vibrant in early October; the south runs into early November.

illinois.note: North peaks by mid-October, central mid to late October, south late October to early November.

indiana.note: Mid to late October for most of the state; the far southwest is late October.

iowa.note: Average peak is the weekend closest to October 10 in the north; the south runs into late October.

kansas.note: Based on the 2026 Kansas Tourism note, not a long-term average.

kentucky.note: Color starts at high elevations in the east and moves west through October into early November. Sources give no exact peak week.

maine.note: Zones 6 and 7 peak around the last week of September; the coast peaks October 21 to 27.

maryland.note: Based on the 2025 Maryland Forest Service forecast, from Garrett County to the Eastern Shore.

massachusetts.note: Based on the 2025 DCR forecast of mid-October peak for most of the state.

michigan.note: Western U.P. turns first; the southern Lower Peninsula peaks in late October.

minnesota.note: The DNR runs the season from late September through mid-October, starting in the northwest.

mississippi.note: Tourism puts the statewide peak from late October through mid-November.

missouri.note: MDC says peak is usually around mid-October, starting in the north and west.

montana.note: Western larch peak mid to late October; alpine larch turns in October at elevation.

nebraska.note: Color begins around the first of October in the northwest; the southeast peaks just before Halloween.

nevada.note: Great Basin color is September or early October, before the snow.

new-hampshire.note: Great North Woods turn in the last week of September; the south and coast peak in the second half of October.

new-mexico.note: Mountain forests peak late September to early October; lower river cottonwoods later in October.

new-york.note: Adirondacks start first; the Hudson Valley and Finger Lakes run into early November.

north-carolina.note: High Country starts late September and color moves downhill toward early November.

ohio.note: Based on the 2026 forecast, from the far north in mid-October to southern Ohio at the start of November.

oklahoma.note: TravelOK puts peak in late October and the first week of November.

oregon.note: Central Oregon and the Willamette Valley peak mid-October; the Gorge and southern Oregon in late October.

pennsylvania.note: DCNR runs from October 1 in the north to October 20 to 31 in the south-central and southeast.

rhode-island.note: The change starts in the north in early October; mid to late October is the usual peak.

south-carolina.note: Mountains begin mid-to-late October; the coast follows in November.

south-dakota.note: The Black Hills prime season is mid-September through mid-October; lower country runs a week or two later.

tennessee.note: East Tennessee peaks around the third week of October; middle and west Tennessee around Halloween into November.

texas.note: Lost Maples runs the last two weeks of October through mid-November; other regions are not published.

utah.note: Best viewing begins mid-September at the highest elevations and wraps in early October in most places.

vermont.note: Peak stage is the last week of September and the first week of October, with late stage in mid to late October.

virginia.note: Mountain parks mid to late October; central parks early November.

washington.note: Mid-September to early November overall, with mid-October the best chance.

west-virginia.note: Potomac Highlands start in late September; southern West Virginia and the Eastern Panhandle in late October.

wisconsin.note: The north peaks the last week of September, central mid-October, the south late October.

wyoming.note: Early September to mid-October, with Aspen Alley peaking in late September.
